title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Acts 2: the day of Pentecost, Peter's sermon to the crowd, and the first believers together.

questions.text: On what day were they all with one accord in one place?
questions.explanation: Acts 2:1 says that when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

answers.text: The first day of the week

questions.text: What came suddenly from the sky and filled the house?
questions.explanation: There came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

answers.text: A sound like a rushing mighty wind

questions.text: What appeared and was distributed to them, one on each?
questions.explanation: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.

questions.text: What did they begin to do when they were filled with the Holy Spirit?
questions.explanation: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability.

answers.text: They went out into the temple
They began to speak with other languages

questions.text: What did those who mocked say about them?
questions.explanation: Others, mocking, said that they were filled with new wine.

answers.text: That they were filled with new wine
That they were teaching a new law
That they were out of their minds

questions.text: What hour of the day did Peter say it was?
questions.explanation: Peter said they were not drunken as the crowd supposed, seeing it was only the third hour of the day.

questions.text: Through which prophet did Peter say this had been spoken?
questions.explanation: Peter said that this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel.

questions.text: According to the words Peter quoted, what will the sun be turned into?
questions.explanation: The quoted words say the sun will be turned into darkness and the moon into blood before the day of the Lord comes.

questions.text: What did Peter tell the crowd to do when they asked what they should do?
questions.explanation: Peter told them to repent and be baptized, every one of them, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins.

answers.text: To go up to the temple at once
To repent and be baptized in Jesus' name
To wait in silence for the Spirit

questions.text: About how many souls were added that day?
questions.explanation: Those who gladly received his word were baptized, and about three thousand souls were added that day.
